title: Bill Split Check
description: Stops a bill split that quietly overcharges someone by checking an item-by-item split against the printed receipt, catching unclaimed items, tax counted twice, a tip on top of a service charge, a total that doesn't match and what an equal split costs the lightest eater, each with a one-tap fix and Undo, with shares rounded by largest remainder so they always add up and each row saying who owes the payer what.
stops: Tip added on top of service charge
mistakes: tip and service charge both paid
item nobody claimed on the bill
equal split unfair to light eater
